chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Muhammad ibn Ali, from Yunus ibn Yaqub, from Abdul A' from Abdul A'ala, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Any group of four men who gather upon a single matter and supplicate to Allah, they do not disperse except having received an answer.

key_terms.رَهْطٍ: A group or company of men

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual benefit of a small group of four people praying together?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi highlights the spiritual potency of collective supplication, specifically noting that a gathering of four individuals praying with unity is assured of divine response. In Shia scholarly tradition, this underscores the concept of 'ijab' (acceptance) as a guaranteed outcome rather than a mere possibility, reinforcing the communal nature of worship and the efficacy of du'a when performed in small, focused groups.
